newsitem.title: USA: Aksys adopts share rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Aksys adopts share rights plan.

text.p: Aksys Ltd said Wednesday its board has adopted a stockholder rights plan and has declared a dividend of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding share of the company's common stock.
Each right will entitle a stockholder of record on November 8 to buy one one-thousandth of a share of a new series of junior participating preferred stock for an exercise price of $85.
The rights will expire on October 28, 2006, unless previously redeemed or exercised.

Aksys, wich develops personal hemodialysis products and services for patients suffering from kidney failure, said the rights plan was adopted to guard against coercive tactics in the event of a takeover attempt.
The rights would become exercisable only if a person acquires or announced a tender offer for 15 percent or more of the company's common stock.
